feeds.title: Alliance of Hope
feeds.description: The Alliance of Hope for Suicide Loss Survivors provides healing support for people who have lost loved ones to suicide. The website is filled with information to help survivors. Follow to keep up with our blog.

feeds.title: Our Side of Suicide
feeds.description: Our Side of Suicide offers hope, inspiration, and support to those who have lost a loved one to suicide. It is a survivor of a suicide group. Follow us to keep up with our blog.

feeds.title: Mindful Survivor » suicide
feeds.description: I'm a mental health blogger, trying to raise awareness through my writing. My blog is my space to express my musings, I usually just talk about my experience. Follow to get the updates.

feeds.title: Surviving After a Suicide Loss
feeds.description: Our weekly peer-run Suicide Loss Support Group in Naples is a safe place for survivors of suicide loss to process grief, receive support and heal in time. Follow Surviving After a Suicide Loss to get the latest updates.

feeds.title: Live Through This
feeds.description: Live Through This is a collection of portrait and true stories of suicide attempt survivors across the United States. Follow us to keep up with our blog.

feeds.title: Diving Into Death
feeds.description: True stories of unbearable pain and loss, impossible choices in the aftermath, and the search for realistic reasons to go on.

feeds.title: The Gift of Second
feeds.description: The Gift of Second is for people that have lost a loved one to suicide. We want it to be a place for anyone suffering from this tremendous loss to find hope, encouragement, understanding, and community. Follow us to keep up with our blog.

feeds.title: Survivors of Bereavement by Suicide - News
feeds.description: Survivors of Bereavement by Suicide exist to break the isolation experienced by many bereaved by suicide. The organization works to support and assist clients to make a transition from vulnerability and fragmented feelings to those of increased self-worth and confidence. Follow to overcome the isolation of people bereaved by suicide

feeds.title: Letters To Brian Blog
feeds.description: I lost my only sibling, my brother Brian, to suicide in 2010. Since then I've been writing letters to him to document my continuing grief process. Follow Letters To Brian Blog to know my story.

feeds.title: Misfire Blog
feeds.description: Misfire blog is about an honest look at suicide. It contains the stories, the facts, and the fiction. It is about those who considered suicide and how they fought it. And for those who suffered by being left behind, how they reconstructed their lives. This is not about endings but beginnings. Please stay, read and tell your story.
